svg.aria-label: Animation. Two images share most of their files. As layers, a layer is kept once only when it is the same; image B's top layer differs by one file, so spring.jar and jackson.jar are stored again: 8 files. podbag stores each file once: 6 files. Measured with 8 Spring services in 2 releases: 2,970 MiB on disk with layers (Docker), 902 MiB with podbag.
svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', 'Hiragino Sans', 'Yu Gothic', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans CJK KR', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Two images stored as layers, and as files

text.tspan: Two images share most of their files
Layers: one file differs, so the whole layer is stored
Files: podbag stores each file once
Measured with 8 Spring services in 2 releases
